title: Buffered console output
responsibility: Routes console.log through the stdout stream so large piped output is queued instead of truncated at a direct-write buffer boundary.

outputs.name: pipedOutput
outputs.description: Returns no value and replaces `console.log` with a function that formats its arguments using `node:util.format` and writes one newline-terminated string to `process.stdout`. This matters for piped output because the stdout stream queues what does not fit its buffer and flushes it before process exit; only `console.log` is replaced.
